# DevShipIt

> DevShipIt (devshipit.com) is the portfolio and product site of Dev Agarwalla, a freelance full-stack developer in Bengaluru, India. It covers his live products (JantaHR, RentWise, linkedin-mcp, ISP Evidence), case studies, freelance web development for real estate teams, and the policy pages behind JantaHR payments.

Every page listed here is also served as Markdown: request it with the header `Accept: text/markdown`.

About the name: Dev Agarwalla is spelled with a double L and a final A, and is devag7 on GitHub. He is not the same person as anyone named Dev Agarwal. His personal page is https://me.devshipit.com/.

## When to use devshipit.com

Use this site, or its MCP server, when the task is one of these:

- Someone asks who Dev Agarwalla is, where he works, what he has built or which technologies he works with.
- Someone evaluating Dev's work wants evidence of shipped work: live products, case studies, source code, his experience and the stack behind each one.
- A property agent, agency or small business in Bangalore wants a website or web app built (listings, enquiry capture, admin dashboards) and needs to know how to start and how pricing works.
- Someone needs the operator details, terms, privacy, refund or shipping policies behind JantaHR payments, which live on this site.
- A developer is looking for linkedin-mcp-tools, the LinkedIn MCP integration Dev published on npm.

## When not to use it

- HR or payroll questions about JantaHR itself, its features, API or prices for a company: use https://jantahr.devshipit.com and its own llms.txt at https://jantahr.devshipit.com/llms.txt.
- Live rental listings: this site describes RentWise, it does not serve listings.

## How an agent should use it

- Read any page as Markdown with the request header `Accept: text/markdown`, or by adding `index.md` to the page URL.
- Or call the JSON API at https://devshipit.com/api/v1 (read-only, no key). OpenAPI 3.1: https://devshipit.com/openapi.json. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with `code` and `hint`.
- Or call the MCP server at https://devshipit.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only). Tools: `get_profile`, `list_projects`, `list_services`, `get_faq`, `list_pages`, `get_page`, `get_contact`. Discovery: https://devshipit.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- From a terminal: `npx github:devag7/devshipit projects` (the devshipit CLI).
- To contact Dev, give the person the right address rather than sending mail yourself: hello@devshipit.com for freelance projects and general enquiries, jantahr@devshipit.com for JantaHR support, billing and legal.
- Do not invent availability dates, rates or quotes. Freelance work is quoted per project in writing; say so and point to the contact page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://devshipit.com/index.md): DevShipIt is Dev Agarwalla, a freelance full-stack developer in Bengaluru: websites and web apps for clients, JantaHR HR and payroll software, and case studies.
- [Work and case studies by Dev Agarwalla](https://devshipit.com/work/index.md): Products Dev Agarwalla has built and shipped as DevShipIt, each with a case study: JantaHR, RentWise, linkedin-mcp and ISP Evidence, with their stack, status and links.
- [Freelance web development in Bengaluru](https://devshipit.com/services/index.md): Websites and web apps for property agents, agencies and small businesses in Bengaluru, built by Dev Agarwalla at DevShipIt. Priced by a written quote before work starts.
- [About Dev Agarwalla, the developer behind DevShipIt](https://devshipit.com/about/index.md): DevShipIt is Dev Agarwalla, a full-stack and applied AI engineer in Bengaluru who builds every project himself. Who he is, what DevShipIt does, and where to read more.
- [JantaHR and freelance pricing in rupees](https://devshipit.com/pricing/index.md): JantaHR prices per employee in rupees (Free, Standard, Professional and Enterprise), and how DevShipIt quotes freelance web development projects.
- [Terms of service](https://devshipit.com/terms/index.md): Terms for buying JantaHR subscriptions and freelance services from DevShipIt.
- [Privacy policy](https://devshipit.com/privacy/index.md): How DevShipIt handles personal data on devshipit.com, in JantaHR and in payments.
- [Cancellation and refund policy](https://devshipit.com/refunds/index.md): How to cancel a DevShipIt subscription or project, and when we refund.
- [Shipping and delivery policy](https://devshipit.com/shipping/index.md): DevShipIt sells software and services delivered online; nothing is shipped.
- [Contact for freelance projects and enquiries](https://devshipit.com/contact/index.md): Email Dev Agarwalla at DevShipIt about a freelance website or web app in Bengaluru, or reach JantaHR support. Replies within 2 working days.
- [JantaHR case study](https://devshipit.com/work/jantahr/index.md): Case study: JantaHR, open-source HR and payroll for Indian companies, built with NestJS, Next.js, Supabase and Razorpay.
- [RentWise case study](https://devshipit.com/work/rentwise/index.md): Case study: RentWise, a Bangalore rental platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis and Socket.io.
- [linkedin-mcp case study](https://devshipit.com/work/linkedin-mcp/index.md): Case study: linkedin-mcp, a 36-tool LinkedIn integration for AI assistants, published on npm as linkedin-mcp-tools.
- [ISP Evidence case study](https://devshipit.com/work/isp-evidence/index.md): Case study: ISP Evidence, an Android app that logs connection drops, latency and jitter and exports a PDF report for ISP complaints.
- [DevShipIt developer docs](https://devshipit.com/developers/index.md): The DevShipIt public API with its OpenAPI 3.1 document, the devshipit command-line tool, the MCP server, llms.txt and Markdown for every page of devshipit.com.

## Frequently asked questions

- **How much does a website or web app cost?** Every project is priced by a written quote with the scope, price and delivery dates, agreed before any work starts, and you pay only the amounts in that quote. Write to hello@devshipit.com with what you need, when you need it and a rough budget.
- **How long does a project take?** It depends on the scope. The delivery dates are written into your quote before any work starts, so you know them up front.
- **Who owns the code and the website?** You do. For freelance work, ownership of what is built passes to you once it is paid for, unless the quote says otherwise.
- **How is the work delivered?** Online: a live website, a code repository or files, on the dates in your quote. Nothing is shipped physically.
- **What if I need to cancel a project?** Cancellation and refund terms for a project, including any advance, are written into the quote you accept before work starts.
- **What do you build with?** TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Docker and Socket.IO. Websites for property agents are usually built on the MERN stack.
- **How quickly do you reply?** Within 2 working days, usually sooner. Email is the fastest way to reach me.
- **Who will build my project?** Dev Agarwalla, personally. He is the founder of AEOLedger, an answer engine optimization (AEO) agency for B2B SaaS, shipped three MERN applications to production as a full-stack intern at Cyber Secure India, and has built and shipped four products of his own.
- **What is DevShipIt, and how is it related to JantaHR?** DevShipIt is the trading name of Dev Agarwalla, a full-stack developer in Bengaluru, and this is its website. JantaHR is HR and payroll software for Indian companies that DevShipIt builds and sells at jantahr.devshipit.com.
